setup: CLAUDE.md configures Products: Acme Notes, Acme Health, Acme Learn; routing hints: wearables/sleep -> Acme Health, notes/memory -> Acme Notes.

evals.prompt: Log this Acme Notes feedback: "Honestly the onboarding blew me away, felt like it actually understood me within minutes. But then the app crashed twice when I tried to connect my Google account and I almost gave up." — beta user, signed up yesterday
evals.expected_output: Creates Customer_Feedback.md if absent, files under Acme Notes, net rating around -1 or 0 (praise + blocking bug), Liked = onboarding/understanding, Bug = [High] Google connect crash, two quotes, ledger row added, HTML regenerated, count=1.

evals.prompt: here's a user comment to capture: the wearable sync is hit or miss, sometimes my sleep data just doesn't show up. but when it works the daily energy insights are genuinely useful and i check them every morning.
evals.expected_output: Routes to Acme Health (wearable routing hint), rating 0/mixed, Liked = energy insights / daily habit, Disliked or Bug = sync reliability, ledger row, HTML + counts updated.

evals.prompt: add another piece of acme notes feedback — "the memory feature is the killer app for me, nothing else remembers context like this. would pay double." power user from the community forum
evals.expected_output: Files under existing Acme Notes section, rating +2, Liked = memory/context + willingness to pay, positive quote, ledger row appended (id 2 for Acme Notes), Acme Notes count -> 2 and band recomputed; no overall score.

evals.prompt: got some feedback but not sure where it goes: "the AI coach kept losing the thread of our conversation and I had to repeat myself a lot."
evals.expected_output: Product is ambiguous (could be several) — skill should ASK one clarifying question to identify the product rather than guessing/misfiling.
